Dear Mr.Mayor and Members of City Council,
Please accept this letter as request for your consideration for a retail liquor license transfer for the
above-referenced restaurant.As you may be aware, Old Chicago Cheyenne opened some years ago
as a franchised location owned and operated by OC Cheyenne, LLC .At this time, the parties have
mutually decided to convert this location to a corporate store. Given the extensive scope of the Old
Chicago operations in Colorado, migrating in to the Cheyenne market makes sense from a
managerial, training, and marketing perspective.We're excited about the possibility of our first
corporate restaurant in Wyoming.
Given this transfer is from franchisee to franchisor, we anticipate minimal changes for the guests
and staff.We have designated capital to provide a minor refresh to this restaurant including decor
upgrades that may include a new AV package, paint, lighting and signage as well as a regional
marketing plan. There will be no, however, premise or structural changes that deviate from the floor
plan of record.We further pride ourselves on our responsible service of alcohol training program
and, as described in further details in other application materials, will assure this location meets or
exceeds our training requirements.
We appreciate your consideration of our application and invite you to contact us with any questions
you may have or additional information that would be helpful with your deliberation. Thank you.
Res peet fully,
Courtney Mow ry
